behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
docDelivery: Explain own-key graph traversal, terminal/chain cycle convention, independent reports and no network.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Implement follow(start,links) and integrate report(starts,links). This is a local name graph, not HTTP/network. links own string keys map to string names; inherited keys ignored, any string name including __proto__ is allowed. follow visits start then targets until missing outgoing edge or repeat; returns {chain,terminal,cycle}. chain contains each first visited name once; terminal is last name for normal stop, repeated target for cycle. report joins chain with " -> "; a cycle adds " -> [cycle:TERMINAL]"; join requested starts with LF in input order, no final LF. Independent walks; inputs unchanged; finite <=1000 keys. Empty strings are valid targets.
manualBehavior: report uses follow rather than separate graph traversal
independence: Explicit synthetic library contract; alternatives judged by observable exports and required integration, not reference-source matching.
